languageRequirements.minimum: Class placement follows the university entry test. The published HSK3 / HSK4–5 levels are learning goals; no mandatory HSK entrance score is specified.

languagePolicy.en: The official notice explicitly lists English and Chinese as teaching languages.
languagePolicy.zh: 官方简章明确列为英文及中文授课。

eligibility.en: Non-Chinese citizen aged 17–50, in good physical and mental health, with no illegal or disciplinary record; comply with Chinese law and university rules.
eligibility.zh: 非中国籍、17—50周岁，身心健康，无违法违纪记录，并遵守中国法律法规及校规。

eligibility.en: Able to fund study and living costs in China. The notice requests an academic certificate but does not specify a minimum qualification level.
eligibility.zh: 能够承担在华学习和生活费用。简章要求学历证明，但未明确最低学历等级。

eligibility.en: Class level is assigned using an entry test. HSK3 and HSK4/5 are the stated learning goals for elementary and intermediate classes, rather than published entrance-score thresholds.
eligibility.zh: 学校依入学测试安排班级。初级HSK3、中级HSK4/5属于学习目标，并非简章公布的入学分数门槛。

applicationMaterials.en: Passport identity page; the notice requires validity beyond September 2027. Renew the passport before applying if necessary.
applicationMaterials.zh: 护照首页；简章要求有效期晚于2027年9月，不符合时先换发护照。

applicationMaterials.en: Academic transcripts and a notarized academic certificate. If either document is not in Chinese or English, provide a notarized Chinese or English translation.
applicationMaterials.zh: 成绩单；经公证的学历证明。两类文件如非中英文，须另附经公证的中文或英文译文。

applicationMaterials.en: Complete Foreigner Physical Examination Form in English, with the doctor signature, hospital seal and stamped photo; retain the original. Results are valid for six months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 英文填写且检查项目完整的外国人体格检查表，须有医生签名、医院公章及盖章照片；保留原件，体检结果有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: Bank statement, deposit certificate or signed sponsor statement covering tuition and living expenses in China.
applicationMaterials.zh: 足以承担在华学费和生活费的银行对账单、存款证明或担保人签署的资助证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Valid non-criminal record issued by the local public security authority, normally within six months before the application.
applicationMaterials.zh: 所在地公安机关出具的有效无犯罪记录证明，通常应在申请日前6个月以内开具。

applicationMaterials.en: Applicants under 18 must provide legal documents for an entrusted guardian in China. Applicants already in China must also provide their current visa or residence-permit page.
applicationMaterials.zh: 未满18周岁须提供在华委托监护法律文件；已在中国者另须提供现持签证或居留许可页。

applicationMaterials.en: Upload clear, genuine and valid documents through the online system. Email and paper applications are not accepted.
applicationMaterials.zh: 材料须清晰、真实、有效并通过系统上传；不接受邮件或纸质申请。

tuitionSchedule.en: CNY 7,000 per semester; CNY 14,000 per academic year

notes.en: Spring 2027: the notice publishes 1 January 2027 as the application end date and also says to complete the online application before that date; apply early and confirm the exact cutoff with the university. An exact opening date is not supplied. The spring term is March–July; elementary study lasts two semesters and intermediate study one semester. Application fee CNY400 is non-refundable and payable after preliminary qualification review. Tuition is CNY7000/semester or CNY14000/academic year; all fees become non-refundable once courses start. Insurance is CNY1000/year; the advertised Xipu double-room accommodation is CNY365/month excluding utilities, subject to availability. The entry test determines placement; the notice does not state a mandatory HSK admission score. The school calls this its 2027 guide; the site groups spring 2027 under the 2026–2027 academic-year filter.
notes.zh: 2027年春季简章公布报名截止为2027年1月1日，另要求在该日前完成网上申请；请提前报名并向学校确认精确截止时点，简章未给出明确起报日期。春季学期为3—7月；初级2学期，中级1学期。初审合格后缴400元报名费且不退。学费每学期7000元、每学年14000元；课程开始后所有费用不退。保险1000元/年；犀浦校区双人间标价365元/月，不含水电且以房源为准。班级依入学测试确定，简章未公布必须达到的入学HSK分数。学校称“2027学年”简章，本站按春季入学将该批次归入2026—2027学年筛选。
